url.description: Page address, usually a web_search result url. Accepts a public HTTP or HTTPS URL up to 8192 characters. Supply exactly one of url or page_id.

page_id.description: Snapshot identifier returned to this client by an earlier web_open. Rereads the cached snapshot without a network request. Supply exactly one of url or page_id. Unknown or expired IDs return page_unavailable. Then open the url again.

start_line.description: First line to return, 1-based. Accepts 1–10000, default 1. To continue reading, pass the previous next_start_line together with the same page_id.

max_lines.description: Maximum lines to return. Accepts 1–500, default 200. Fewer lines may return to fit the response budget. Then next_start_line points to the first omitted line.
